Repository files navigation # 🆓 Free API Bazaar [Permalink: 🆓 Free API Bazaar](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar#-free-api-bazaar) > A categorized, community-maintained directory of free LLM & AI APIs. [![Mega AI Bazaar](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/2c7bb3931638506a097444c9b37a352c390ef2a3cc3bb3ee389f28b81df7907a/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f2546302539462538432539305f4d6567615f41495f42617a6161722d62726f7773655f616c6c2d364335434537)](https://drvivek34.github.io/Mega-AI-Bazaar/)[![Submit](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/37c6fe6bf861b989135fd9965f041f55ce4bf7a1cb5c337231f23854185b267c/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f2545322539452539355f5375626d69742d615f667265655f415049732d326563633731)](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/issues/new/choose)[![License](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/d6bc2b26794002c24d023acaab01b6dbb953c57ab9cb80ba5b8aa2f2bd5de99a/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f4c6963656e73652d4d49542d626c7565)](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/LICENSE) Free API Bazaar (formerly awesome free LLM API resources) is a living catalog of providers that offer free or free-tier access to LLMs, image, audio, video, embeddings, and multimodal models — with their real limits, OpenAI-compatibility, and signup links. The most generous picks are surfaced in **featured/**. ## 📂 Categories [Permalink: 📂 Categories](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar#-categories) **[⭐ [Embeddings](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/embeddings) | Free embedding / vector APIs. | | [Free LLM limits, gotchas, and reliability. | | [Video Generation](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/video-generation) | Free text-to-video / video APIs. | | [Vision & Multimodal](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/vision-multimodal) | Free vision and multimodal model APIs. | ## 🗂️ How it's organized [Permalink: 🗂️ How it's organized](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar#%EF%B8%8F-how-its-organized) Every free APIs lives in its **own sub-folder** inside a category, with a `README.md` recording its **source, author, and original license** (a full copy of the files is kept). See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)**. ## ➕ Contribute [Permalink: ➕ Contribute](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar#-contribute) - **[Submit via the form](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/issues/new/choose)** (easiest), or open a PR. - Attribution is mandatory — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## 📜 License & attribution [Permalink: 📜 License & attribution](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar#-license--attribution) Repository structure and original text: **MIT** (see [LICENSE](https://github.com/Drvivek34/Free-API-Bazaar/blob/main/LICENSE)). Each collected free APIs **retains its original author's license**; entries record their source. If you're an author and want a change, open an issue. * * * Part of the **[Mega AI Bazaar](https://drvivek34.github.io/Mega-AI-Bazaar/)** — the front door to all the bazaars. ## About 🆓 Free API Bazaar — a directory of free LLM & AI APIs with their real limits (formerly 'awesome free LLM API resources').
